sources.title: Simulation Engine - JOSHUA Documentation
sources.snippet: Simulation Engine The JOSHUA Simulation Engine provides a comprehensive physics simulation environment built on MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact). It supports multiple operational modes for development, testing, validation, and training—from interactive GUI manipulation to GPU-accelerated reinforcement learning with thousands of parallel environments.

sources.title: CMFFN: An efficient cross-modal feature fusion network for semantic ...
sources.snippet: We propose a novel approach to cross-modal fusion, termed CMFFN. This method utilises the geometric features and positional information of raw point clouds, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) bimodal fusion results with significantly reduced computational and memory costs.
